subject: Mobile Development
title: Fortnite Breaks the Rules
description: A 60-second lesson on Fortnite Breaks the Rules.

hook.text: On August 13, 2020, Epic Games deliberately violated Apple's rules inside Fortnite.

buildup.text: Epic added a direct payment option in Fortnite, bypassing Apple's 30% commission.

discovery.text: Apple removed Fortnite from the App Store within hours, exactly as Epic had planned.

twist.text: Epic immediately filed a lawsuit and launched a PR campaign called 'Free Fortnite.'

climax.text: Epic orchestrated the entire confrontation as a deliberate legal and PR strategy.

punchline.text: Epic didn't break the rules by accident. It was a trap.

quiz.question: Why did Epic add a direct payment option in Fortnite?
options: To deliberately provoke Apple and trigger a legal battle
